title: Hand-built continuous linear transpose between Euclidean spaces
statement: For all natural numbers n, m there is a continuous linear map tau : L(R^n, R^m) -> L(R^m, R^n) (both spaces of continuous linear maps with the operator norm) such that for every continuous linear L : R^n -> R^m and all w in R^m, v in R^n: <tau(L) w, v> = <w, L v>. Here R^k = EuclideanSpace R (Fin k) = Rn k with its standard inner product.
lean_statement: ∀ (n m : ℕ), ∃ τ : (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn m) →L[ℝ] (Rn m →L[ℝ] Rn n), ∀ (L : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn m) (w : Rn m) (v : Rn n), inner ℝ (τ L w) v = inner ℝ w (L v)
